ADITI RAO HYDARI CANNES 2026 LOOKS: ACTOR TURNS HEADS IN REGAL CHAMPAGNE SAREE AND BOLD NEON GREEN COUTURE GOWN
May 18, 2026

Rishika Singh

Aditi Rao Hydari returned to Cannes Film Festival 2026 with two striking looks that quickly caught attention on the red carpet. Representing L'Oréal Paris, she moved from a traditional champagne silk saree to a bold neon green gown with ease.

Aditi Rao Hydari in a Jade Saree at Cannes 2026

Aditi stepped onto the red carpet in a champagne silk tissue saree by Jade by Monica and Karishma, drawing inspiration from the Chaarbagh, the four-part Mughal garden layout.

The Craftsmanship Behind the Saree

The saree brought together four archival block-printing patterns from different Indian craft traditions, finished with Kasab embroidery and metallic Mughal-style threadwork.

How Aditi Styled the Jade Look

Styled by Sanam Ratansi, she wore her hair in a soft loose bun, paired the saree with a gold-toned necklace and kept the makeup clean with a mauve lip. No heavy accessories, letting the saree do the talking.

Aditi Rao Hydari in a Tony Ward Gown

For her second appearance, Aditi went full glam in a neon metallic green one-shoulder gown from Tony Ward Couture's SS25 collection, and yes, it stopped the show.

The Details of the Neon Green Gown

The gown featured an embellished upper half, a thigh-high slit and a dramatic train. The metallic finish caught the light beautifully and the structured bodice balanced the fluidity of the skirt.

How Aditi Styled the Tony Ward Look

She kept the accessories minimal with a delicate diamond necklace, opted for soft pink lips, winged liner and wore her hair in loose waves.

Aditi Rao Hydari Continues to Own Cannes

Aditi has made Cannes a space where Indian fashion gets its moment, and this year she has done it again. We are already waiting to see what she has lined up next.
